integrity: Analytic infinite-dimensional proof supplied. Standalone reproducibility checks use exact fractions and finite tridiagonal numerical diagnostics. No numerical test is treated as a completeness proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the specified geometrically thinned, square-root-amplitude Rhaly rows and the explicit triangular family, not arbitrary Rhaly matrices. Infinite-dimensional proof uses classical Meixner completeness and Carleman essential selfadjointness. Possible unrecognized classical equivalent spectral representation remains a publication-priority risk; independent audit not performed.
title: An exact arithmetic singular spectrum for geometrically thinned Rhaly matrices
